tasks.subject: Task 0: Put the hardening work on its own branch and commit it
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Move uncommitted hardening changes from chore/unify-github-workflows to fix/hardening (from main) and commit them.

**Verify:** git log --oneline main..fix/hardening -> 1 commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["components/gatepro/gatepro.cpp", "components/gatepro/gatepro.h", "components/gatepro/cover.py", "docs/hardening-review.md"], "verifyCommand": "git log --oneline main..fix/hardening", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fix/hardening from main with one commit", ".gitignore left for owner decision"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Extract protocol helpers into gatepro_protocol.h with host tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Dependency-free protocol header covered by host unit tests compiled with -fno-exceptions.

**Verify:** g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-exceptions -I components/gatepro tests/test_protocol.cpp -o build/test_protocol && ./build/test_protocol

```json:metadata
{"files": ["components/gatepro/gatepro_protocol.h", "tests/test_protocol.cpp", "components/gatepro/gatepro.cpp", "components/gatepro/gatepro.h", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "mkdir -p build && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-exceptions -I components/gatepro tests/test_protocol.cpp -o build/test_protocol && ./build/test_protocol", "acceptanceCriteria": ["tests pass", "helpers removed from gatepro.cpp", "firmware compiles without gatepro warnings"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: CI compiles the PR's own component and runs the unit tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** CI matrix includes gatepro_boxer_local.yaml and a unit-tests job. Depends on chore/unify-github-workflows being merged first.

**Verify:** gh pr checks <PR#>

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/esphome.yml"], "verifyCommand": "gh pr checks --watch", "acceptanceCriteria": ["local yaml in compile matrix", "unit-tests job green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Remove dead code
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Remove update_state_from_position, start_direction_, debug, blocker, consecutive_position_readings_, last_position_reading_, devinfo.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["components/gatepro/gatepro.h", "components/gatepro/gatepro.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "grep -nE \"update_state_from_position|start_direction_|void debug|blocker|consecutive_position_readings_|last_position_reading_|std::string devinfo\" components/gatepro/*", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no dead members left", "tests and firmware compile pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Real-device verification
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Manual verification on the gate: STOP priority, partial position, stale target, same position, toggle, parameter write. Record results in docs/hardening-review.md.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/hardening-review.md"], "verifyCommand": "esphome logs examples/gatepro_boxer_local.yaml", "acceptanceCriteria": ["all scenarios as expected and recorded"]}
```

tasks.description:

{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "git branch -a | grep precheck", "acceptanceCriteria": ["owner confirmed", "branch deleted"]}
